chapter: After the Paradise: club dates and Virginia
title: Buying a Chrysler Imperial and driving to Florida
summary: He bought a used Chrysler Imperial in 1954 for about 2300 dollars, had a tire stolen in Cleveland and drove 1400 miles to Florida.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: So this was your first car, the Chrysler Imperial?
Yeah. I bought that when I was at the Bamboo Club. Yeah.
How much did that cost, just out of curiosity?
I don't know. It wasn't a new one. It was a used one. I think I paid like 2300 or somethin' like that for it. But I loved that car. I kept that car until it just fell apart. But anyway...
You bought it and drove right down to Florida to pick up this gig down there?
Yeah. Well, I had it for a little while, you know. But it was still 'used/new'. (laughter) And so...I'll never forget on our way down we was in Cleveland in Gleason's

where they had acts and what not and I was stayin' at this hotel and I just bought all these brand new tires, I think they were Kelly Tires. So I got up the next mornin' and I noticed that my hood, my trunk hood was up. Somebody durin' the night had sneaked in there and opened my trunk and took the tire out (laughter) and the money was tight and so I had to drive all the way to Florida on four tires. (laughter) A wing and a prayer. Then when I got down to Florida I found out that they'd put a Crown Imperial...I needed new valves...they'd put a Crown Imperial motor in an Imperial Chrysler. So when they went to get the valves they said, "Well these are Crown Imperial...so you gotta have..." I'm tellin' you that was really somethin'. But anyway, they had a place called the Sir John Hotel which was in the colored section of town. So I was so disgusted, because I could see the job goin' down the drain.
